html:
Greetings, Agents

 

This is CM Fragment of the MARVEL Future Fight Team.
 
Our first update theme for the year 2020 is a <MARVEL Future Fight Original>!
Get ready to meet MARVEL Future Fight original characters that you’ve never seen before!
I'm here to share the January update details with you NOW!!

 

The long-awaited Warriors of the Sky, which introduces 4 new characters, have arrived!
4 new Uniforms have been added to support the Story’s main characters, as well as Sharon Rogers!
9 characters had their potential unlocked to help boost their abilities!
The Lunar Temple Guardians, Crescent & Io, received a Tier-3 upgrade!
A new active skill called an Awakened Skill has been added through character growth!

 

The Agent's first mission is revisited in the new Story Mode with reorganized story content!
Added Support Hero system to improve convenience and to Improve Dimension Mission!
Various improvements have also been made to help our players enjoy the game and its contents such as a continuous enhancement for Gear and the ability to set an Auto-Repeat limit.


▣ Added 4 NEW Characters
 
The 4 new characters that wield the power of the Sky Kyrin have arrived in MARVEL Future Fight!
Check out Blue Dragon, War Tiger, Shadow Shell, and Sun Bird!

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Added 4 NEW Uniforms
 
MARVEL Future Fight’s first original characters and the main characters of the Story have received new Uniforms!
Meet the new Captain America, Iron Man, Black Widow, and Captain America (Sharon Rogers)!

 

※ Skill stats for the new Uniforms are based on skill level 1.
※ The new Uniforms for Captain America, Iron Man, and Black Widow can only be acquired as Story completion rewards.
※The Captain America (Sharon Rogers) New Uniform will be on sale during the event and will be available for purchase in the MARVEL Universe and Uniform Room after the event.
 

▣ 9 More Characters Can Now Realize Their Potential and can advance to Tier-3
Blue Dragon / War Tiger / Shadow Shell / Sun Bird / Songbird / White Tiger / Wiccan / Hulkling / Squirrel Girl had their Potentials unlocked and will be able to reach level 70 after the January Update. 

 

Crescent & Io can now reach level 70!
The third original character in MARVEL Future Fight, the Guardian of the Lunar Temple, Crescent & Io, has awakened with a new ability thanks to her receiving a Tier-3 advancement. 

 

 

 

▣ Added Potential Awakening and New Awakened Skill!
 
Give your character a new Awakened Skill by completing certain conditions.
Skills with a wide range of capabilities will be a great help to your Missions!
 
In order to acquire an Awakened Skill, you'll first need to do a Potential Awakening!
Unlock the Potential Awakening by fulfilling the conditions below.

 

1. Reach LV 70 with a character with an Awakened Skill.
2. Achieve the Growth Conditions of that designated character.
 
Once you’ve completed the Potential Awakening conditions, perform the awakening by using the required materials and currencies!
If the Awakening succeeds, a new active skill called Awakened Skill will be unlocked!

* The conditions of Potential Awakening may vary depending on the characters that will be added in the future. 
* As of the January update, the Awakened Skill is only available for the Warriors of the Sky members.
* In some contents, the initial cooldown is applied to Awakened Skills.
(Contents with Initial cooldown: Battleworld, Timeline Battle, Alliance Conquest, Alliance Tournaments)

 

 

 

 

 

Potential Awakening and Awakened Skill enhancement material “Awakening Crystal” can be obtained from World Boss Ultimate difficulty by certain probabilities and has no Inventory limit.

 

 

Awakened Skills can be used in the same way as basic skills. You can increase the Awakened Skill level via skill upgrade.

 


* The image was taken from a beta test build. The materials and skill effect may differ upon release.
- Skill enhancement requires materials and Gold.
 
 
▣ Story reimagined! New ‘Story’ Content has arrived!
 
An Agent’s first mission!
We’ve remade the main content! Please look forward to the new content of <Story>!

 

1. Updated direction and story progression!

This renewal brings new original lines, battle effects, and special scenes!
This will help you understand the MARVEL Future Fight story!

 

 

 

2. “Save Progress” and Continue Features!

The Story can only be progressed sequentially from the first stage that’s why we have prepared a Save Progress function in consideration for our Agents who cannot play the game for prolonged periods of time.

While playing a stage, you can save the current progress stage that you’ve cleared and continue from where you left off via the continue feature after you exit the stage.

 

 

- Energy is not consumed when you continue playing from your last saved stage!

 

Make use of this function to clear Story until the end.
If you clear the Story until the end, you can replay Story again after the reset.
- The number of resets will be updated daily at 3:00 PM (UTC+0) | 7:00 AM (PST)
- Story reset can only be done once per day.


3. A New Battle System!

The Story only uses designated characters and adds quests such as infiltrations and various combat patterns as well as general battles making the Story interesting.

 

 

4. Attribute System!

You can change a character’s basic skill into another skill. Attributes only apply to Story and you can choose from a total of three skills. Mix and match different Attributes to give you an advantage in your missions!

 

- Attribute Skills are unlocked sequentially based on your stage clear progress.


5. Story Rewards

 

As you progress through the Story, you can grow Captain America, Black Widow, and Iron Man up until Tier-2!
If you already have these characters upgraded, you may receive additional growth materials.

After completing Story, you will receive Chest as rewards that contain items such as Biometrics, Premium Comic Cards, C.T.P. and more!


■ First Stage clear Rewards (Basic character growth)

These are the rewards that you can earn each time you clear an individual stage in a Story.
Complete the Story until the end to rank up Captain America, Black Widow, and Iron Man to Tier-2.

 

 


■ First Chapter Clear Reward (If you have a character who is on above the reward level)

 

This reward will be given if you acquire the first clear reward using a character with a higher level than the pre-assigned characters.

 

The rewards are based on the growth level of Captain America, Iron Man, and Black Widow and can only be claimed once.

   

 

* If you have a character who is above the reward level (Tier-2 Character), you will receive materials such as Gold, Norn Stone, and Biometrics.

 

■ Stage Clear Reward

 

Every time you clear a stage, you will get Biometrics as reward.
In each chapter, you can obtain one of the specified Biometrics as a reward.
Depending on your progress, the number and type of character available will increase!

 

 

 

■ Story Completion Reward

 

This reward is given for completing the Story mode’s last stage.

 

 

* Each of the three completion rewards can only be received once per account.

 

You can earn Comic Cards with some Premium Cards, C.T.P. Odin’s Blessing, 6★ (Awakened) ISO-8, and more from the Story Complete Reward Chest.

 


[Revisions of related content challenges through Story renewal]

 

Due to the original Story Mode being updated, the related challenges and unlock conditions have also been updated. Please refer to the details below.

 

1. Improvements have been made to the S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy.
 - Some missions and rewards from the existing S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy have been changed.
  Story Mode related missions have been changed to Story Clear Missions.

 

2. Some of the rewards that can be obtained from the existing Story missions will be given to the Agents who meet the conditions after we complete the maintenance.

 

- Distribution Reward: Odin
* This reward will be given to Agents who completed the existing Story Mission 3-7 and does not have Odin.
* You will receive items for acquiring 1★ Odin through Inbox.
* The items can only be stored in the Inbox for 30 Days and will be deleted after that period.
* After the update, all existing Odin Biometrics will be deleted
* After the update maintenance, Odin will become available for purchase from the [Store] - [Character] - [Character Acquisition] for 1,750 Crystals.

 

- Distribution Reward: 6★ Blue Marvel, C.T.P. of Energy
* 6★ Blue Marvel and C.T.P. of Energy will be given to Agents who cleared the existing Story Mission Stage 3-7 to 13-7.
* You will not get these rewards if you already cleared the existing Story Mission Stage until 13-8.
※Blue Marvel will be distributed as listed below:
-If you own a 1★ ~ 5★ Blue Marvel: Rank up 6★ Blue Marvel
-If you own a 6★ Blue Marvel: Biometrics: Blue Marvel X 256
*The items can only be stored in the Inbox for 30 Days and will be deleted after that period.

 

3. Changes to the Challenges and conditions for unlocking some content.
- Due to the changes made to Story Mode, some Challenges, continuous Achievements within World and conditions for unlocking content have been changed.

 

[Daily Challenges]
- Challenges associated with the existing Story Missions have been deleted or changed to other terms.
* All Agent’s Daily Challenge history will reset after the update due to the changes made to Story.
* We recommend that you complete all the Challenges after the maintenance considering that some contents have limited entries.

 

[Achievement]
- Achievements associated with existing Story Missions have been removed.
* Achievement Scores are retained for Achievements that you’ve already completed.
* Achievements related to the existing Story that are in progress and not yet awarded will be completed and the rewards sent.

 

[World Boss]
- The Story Clear conditions to unlock Quicksilver’s Normal difficulty has been changed to Contribution reward from Dimension Mission.

 

▣ Improved Dimension Mission!

 

We will be guiding you on the improvements that we’ve made to the Dimension Mission rewards and further refinements!


1. New rewards have been added to Dimension Mission.

- Improved to give Biometrics via the Support Hero when clearing Dimension Mission.
   You can acquire Biometrics from one of the 5 Support Characters listed. 

 


- Support Hero Biometrics / X-Genes rewards can be acquired up to 20 times a day.
- The list of Support Characters will reset at 3:00 PM (UTC+0) | 7:00 AM (PST) and can be reset instantly by using the currencies.
- The list of Support Characters will include one Dimension Chest Character and one Daily Biometrics / X-Gene Characters.
- Daily Biometrics / Daily X-Gene characters have a separate icon above the character portrait.

 


2. In the contribution rewards popup window, you can now see which rewards are currently available and rewards that you already have.

 

 

3. Dimension Mission VIP Perks Improvement  
- 15% chance to double the rewards when clearing Story Missions → 15% chance to double the rewards when clearing Dimension Mission
- Story Mission Daily Biometrics Reset → Discount on Biometric purchases using tokens in the Support Shop.

 

4. [Support Shop]-[Rank Up Materials] After entering the biometric data purchase window and press the back button has been improved to maintain the scroll position.
- Made it easier to purchase a character’s rank up materials.

 

5. The Biometrics of the characters that can be acquired from the exist Story Mission have been added to the Support Shop.


▣ Added a new Hero Package

 

A new Hero Package has been added for Blue Dragon.
You can find it by going to [Store] - [Character] - [Character Acquisition]

 

Upon the first purchase of the Blue Dragon Package, you will receive a 6★ Blue Dragon and Gold. Blue Dragon Biometrics and rank up materials can be acquired from the 2nd purchases.

 

 

* If you already receive Blue Dragon as pre-registration reward, you will receive the following:
- If you already own 1★ - 5★ Blue Dragon, it will automatically be rank up to 6★.
- If you already have a 6★ Blue Dragon, Blue Dragon Package#1 will not be displayed.

 


* Package # 2 can be purchased after purchasing Package # 1.
* The product will become available for purchase until further notice.

 

▣ Added Uniform Collection
 
A Uniform Collection has been created to commemorate the original MARVEL Future Fight Team.
Achieve the designated conditions to complete the collection and get rewarded!
 
[Avengers 3099]

 

 

▣ Other game improvements
 
1. The Custom Gear upgrading function has been improved.
 
If you attempt to change the option again after completing a Custom Gear option change, the Custom Gear that will be used to change the option will remain selected.

 

 

- A popup reminder has been added and will appear based on the following conditions:

 

* If an attempt to replace a  C.T.P. with another Custom Gear is made while it's still equipped
* When a C.T.P. is used as an option to change or as Enhancement material.
* When replacing a Custom Gear with lower rank Custom Gear
* When attempting to use a higher rank Custom Gear for enhancement

 
2. Gear Upgrade +15 to +20 can now be done at the press of a Max Upgrade button. You can now upgrade the Gear from +1 up to +20 all at once.

 

- Maximum Upgrade will stop if materials or Gear level requirements are not met.
- From +21 Gear Upgrade, it will progress 1 level at a time as usual.
- Crystal enhancement is not applicable.


3. Epic Quest, Dimension Mission, and Event Mission have been improved to have the option to set Auto-Repeat count.

 

 

- The progress during Auto-Repeat is displayed and can be stopped.
 
Please note Auto-Repeat may stop before scheduled due to the following cases:
- Insufficient Boost Points
※ Boost Point usage can be adjusted in the Settings to turn on/off.
- If you exceed the Inventory limit
- If all of the characters die 
- If you have acquired all available Biometrics or X-Genes from the mission
 * This function can be adjusted in the Settings to turn on/off.

 

4. Improvements have been made to make it easier to see the main challenge in-game.
- The S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy, Event Quests, and Daily Challenges will be displayed as Achievements. 

 

 

- Tap on the icon shown above to view the Challenges in progress!
- Completed Challenges can be received immediately without switching screens!

 

5. Improvements have been made to the Chat System.
- The Chat Filter has been improved to allow you to not display specific chats by turning them On/ Off.

 

 

<Player Chat Messages> <System Message (Item Acquisition and Growth)>
The filter will allow you to only see the chats that you want.


- Chats that have been sent while in the OFF feature are not displayed even when the filter is changed to ON.
- The filter feature does not apply to Alliance Chats and Chat rooms within certain content.

 

- Chat notifications have improved to activate for you acquire high-rank items as a reward from Contents / Dimension Chests / Selectors.

 

6. Made improvements to the <Daily Perks Packages> where you can instantly browse and see the packages without the need to move from one window to another.

 

 

7. All C.T.P. cannot be sold anymore.
- C.T.P.s can be sold for Gold from the Inventory but after the maintenance, the option to sell will not be available.

 

8. Cosmic Cube Fragment drop rate increased by X 1.5 (+World Boss Strikers Reorganization)

 

Our November update has changed the way World Boss Co-op Skill work that using 1 useful skill.

 

We’ve made changes to provide a better and smoother gameplay experience. Many Agents shared their feedback that they find the changes to be lacking and that the content’s fun factor is lower than expected.

 

In the future, we will adjust the Co-op Skill balance to help improve the World Boss.
World Boss difficulty will also be changed to the previous level. We will make sure to notify you in advance.
In addition, as Tie-3 characters increases, the number of Cosmic Cube Fragments earned in the January update will be increased by 1.5 times.

 

The time and details for the Co-op Skill balance changes will be announced on a later date.

We will do our best to make the game enjoyable and fun to play!

 

9. Alliance Battle Extreme Mode High Score Guide 

   [Added on 1/7 9:48 AM (UTC+0) | 1/7 1:48 AM (PST)]

There has been an on-going discussion about making improvements to the high scores in Alliance Battle Extreme. Since the final adjustments will take some time, we will try to apply the current changes in our upcoming update.

A detailed notice will be posted in the future.
 

10. One-handed mode is not available

One-handed mode will not be available anymore and will be unified with the Virtual Pad mode starting January update.

 [Added on 1/8 11:20 AM (UTC+0) | 1/8 3:20 AM (PST)]

 

▣ Other Game Error Fixes
 
1. An issue has been fixed wherein the C.T.P. of Insight effect applied to team 1 members only in contents consisting of 6 characters
2. An issue has been fixed where the buff icons were not displayed properly in certain situations.
3. An issue has been fixed where EXP and Uniform EXP was not applied properly when playing Dimension Missions.
4. An issue has been fixed where using EXP chips made it look like there was a decrease in the amount of EXP received.
5. An issue has been fixed wherein during the character selection in certain contents and the character sort feature were not shown correctly.
6. An issue has been fixed where the Home Button bar was displayed during gameplay.
7. An issue has been fixed wherein the HP has shown above the character portrait and the HP shown above the character in World Boss Ultimate was different.
8. An issue has been fixed in Legendary Battle <Ant-Man & The Wasp> Extreme Mode Stage 1: Secret of the Pym Particles where players can’t clear the stage due to the opponent Ant-Man and Wasp having continuous iframe.
9. Fixed an issue where the 30th floor in Shadowland could be cleared easily after the Shadowland reset.
10. Fixed an issue where if Iron Man uses his character’s skill that uses beams, he would not be facing the target.
11. Fixed an issue with Deadpool <Lady Deadpool> Active Skill 4 “Perfect Precision” when being previewed in Uniform.
12. Fixed an issue where the HP was not displayed in certain contents.
13. An issue has been fixed where the game would crash when Apocalypse used his Tier-3 Skill in Danger Room.
14. Fixed an issue where the speech bubble was not displayed properly in Giant Boss Raid and World Boss Invasion.
15. Fixed the C.T.P. of Insight’s team buff effect to apply to all team members in Battleworld.
16. Fixed an issue where some Hidden Rewards are not revealed when Hidden Tickets are used while playing in Auto-Repeat in Dimension Missions.
17. Fixed an issue where the buff increase efficiency skill does not appear to apply to some effects in the C.T.P.
18. Fixed an issue where the camera display would freeze under certain conditions in World Boss Ultimate.
19. Fixed a typo with Luna Snow <Lifestyle Series 1> Character Usage Tip (You and Me -> Freezing Dance)
20. (Will be Fixed) The screen is not displayed properly when a boss changes phase in World Boss Ultimate.

21. Fixed an issue where the tips description overlaps in World Event.
22. Fixed an issue where the Character Usage Tips gets duplicated.
23. Fixed an issue where some devices are experiencing issues with downloading the extra resources before entering the lobby.
24. Fixed an issue with Deadpool’s <Holiday Party> Uniform wherein the Tier-3 Advancement animation is not shown properly while equipping the Uniform.
 

Starting with the January update, we will be preparing more characters and improvements this year!

I hope that you will look forward to more updates in the future.

 

Thank you.
